slides.title: Agentic Treasury
slides.subtitle: Open, self-custodied payments infrastructure for AI agents — x402 on-chain trust, verifiable receipts, safe hands.
slides.notes: Pitch deck for the Sentient Open Source AGI Grant. We build the trust layer agents need to act safely.

slides.title: The Problem

bullets.text: An agent with a wallet is a liability.
It either can't move money without a human, or it holds keys with no on-chain accountability.
Agents are crossing from demos into real custody — trading, paying APIs, running treasuries.
The trust layer hasn't shipped with them. Custody is a black box or a single point of failure.
Users and small agents can't afford enterprise custody, and no open alternative exists.

slides.notes: Frame the gap: no open, verifiable way for agents to hold and move value.

slides.title: What We Build

bullets.text: An open x402 gateway that gives AI agents real wallets and safe hands.
Agent receives a 402 payment prompt, authorizes a per-tx micro-fee, settles with an on-chain trust receipt.
Self-custodied, transparent, gated by verifiable rules — no custodian, no middleman.
Live today: 11 pay-per-call services on api.gentechlabs.net with a working interactive demo.

slides.notes: The core value: agents transact autonomously under verifiable on-chain identity.

slides.title: Why Now

bullets.text: Agents are beginning to hold real treasury assets and make real payments.
Without a trust layer, adoption stalls or pushes agents into centralized black boxes.
The x402 standard is gaining traction; the foundation just launched under the Linux Foundation.
The window to build the open rails is open now.

slides.notes: Urgency: agents crossed into real custody; the trust substrate must arrive with them.

bullets.text: 1. Agent requests a protected endpoint → gateway returns HTTP 402 with a payment prompt.
2. Agent authorizes a micro USDC payment and signs it.
3. Gateway verifies the on-chain receipt → releases the response.
4. Every call leaves a verifiable trust receipt on-chain.
No custody. No middleman. Fully auditable.

slides.title: Why This Team

bullets.text: GenTech Labs runs live agent rails every day — treasury classification, LP automation, cross-venue signals, ERC-8004 identity.
We built the treasury because our own agents execute real value.
We've lived its failure modes, so we ship the trust layer it needs.
Agents building the trust layer agents need.

slides.notes: Credibility: we're dogfooding the infra we're asking to build out.

bullets.text: Mainnet hardening (wks 1-4): audited custody, gasless EIP-7702, public trust-receipt schema.
Three new rails (wks 3-8): Base→Avalanche bridge, recurring subscriptions, ERC-8004 identity payments.
Open SDK (wks 6-10): MIT reference bot so any builder pays-per-call in an hour.
Community (wks 8-12): migration guides + onboarding for 5 external teams.

slides.title: Open. Yours. Accessible.

bullets.text: Open — anyone can run it, inspect it, build on it.
Yours to keep — self-custody means no one can cut you off.
Empowering, not extractive — capability, not harvesting.
Aligned with Sentient's principles: private by default, good for humanity.

slides.notes: Map the project directly to Sentient's six funding principles.
